capabilities.name: Find jobs and apply for you
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent find jobs that fit you and send the applications for you?

US.note: LoopCV searches US boards such as Dice and USAJobs, plus LinkedIn and Indeed, and sends applications for you by email or web form. The job boards' own AI stops before the last step: the Indeed and ZipRecruiter apps in ChatGPT send you to their sites to apply, and LinkedIn's Premium Apply Assistant pre-fills forms that you approve.

evidence.title: Knowledge Base (job location, and the job boards LoopCV searches in each market)
About the Indeed app on ChatGPT (you apply on Indeed)
ZipRecruiter launches ChatGPT app for AI-powered job discovery
LinkedIn automates the job application process for Premium users

GB.note: LoopCV searches UK boards such as Reed and CV-Library, plus LinkedIn and Indeed, and sends applications for you by email or web form. Indeed's Career Scout, an AI career tool, reached the UK in July 2026; its UK help page lists applying as a feature but does not say whether it sends applications for you.

evidence.title: Knowledge Base (job location, and the job boards LoopCV searches in each market)
Indeed launches Career Scout to support workers seeking career change

DE.note: LoopCV searches German boards such as StepStone and Xing, plus LinkedIn and Indeed, and sends applications for you by email or web form. We did not find a German job board with its own agent that applies for you.

evidence.title: Knowledge Base (job location, and the job boards LoopCV searches in each market)

IN.note: LoopCV searches Indian boards such as Naukri and Instahyre, plus LinkedIn and Indeed, and sends applications for you by email or web form. We did not find a Naukri agent of its own that applies for you.

evidence.title: Knowledge Base (job location, and the job boards LoopCV searches in each market)

BR.note: Catho's Autoenvio, part of the paid Catho Profissional plan, sends your CV every morning to jobs that match your profile closely and take direct applications, with no click per job.

evidence.title: Autoenvio de currículo: confira mais essa novidade da Catho

MX.note: LoopCV's Spanish blog names Computrabajo, which runs job sites in Mexico, among the boards it searches, but LoopCV does not list Mexico as a market or say it applies here. We searched Computrabajo and OCC Mundial (Nov 2026); no primary source shows a job board here with its own agent that applies for candidates.

evidence.title: Postular a ofertas automáticamente con IA: cómo funciona (InfoJobs, Computrabajo)

CL.note: LoopCV's Spanish blog names Computrabajo, which runs job sites in Chile, among the boards it searches, but LoopCV does not list Chile as a market or say it applies here. We searched Computrabajo, Laborum and Bumeran (Nov 2026); their AI tools screen profiles for recruiters, and no primary source shows an agent that applies for candidates.

evidence.title: Postular a ofertas automáticamente con IA: cómo funciona (InfoJobs, Computrabajo)

CO.note: LoopCV's Spanish blog names Computrabajo, which runs job sites in Colombia, among the boards it searches, but LoopCV does not list Colombia as a market or say it applies here. We searched Computrabajo and elempleo (Nov 2026); no primary source shows a job board here with its own agent that applies for candidates.

evidence.title: Postular a ofertas automáticamente con IA: cómo funciona (InfoJobs, Computrabajo)

ES.note: LoopCV searches InfoJobs, the main Spanish job board, plus LinkedIn and Indeed, and sends applications for you by email or web form. We did not find a Spanish job board with its own agent that applies for you.

evidence.title: Knowledge Base (job location, and the job boards LoopCV searches in each market; InfoJobs for Spain)

FR.note: LoopCV accepts France as a job location and sends applications for you by email when it finds an employer address, and on LinkedIn and Indeed through its Chrome extension; its list of boards names no French board such as France Travail or Welcome to the Jungle. France Travail's own AI tool (ChatFT) serves its advisers, not job seekers.

evidence.title: Knowledge Base (job location, and the job boards LoopCV searches in each market)
France Travail customer story (ChatFT built with Mistral)

CA.note: LoopCV accepts a country-only location and sends applications for you by email or web form; its job-board list names Canada only under LinkedIn, and says coverage varies by country. No Canadian job board with its own applying agent was found.

evidence.title: Knowledge Base (job location, and the job boards LoopCV searches in each market)

JP.note: We found no agent that applies for jobs for you in Japan. Japanese job sites such as Recruit, doda and BizReach use AI for matching and scouting, not for sending applications, and LoopCV's board list names no Japanese board, though it searches LinkedIn worldwide.

evidence.title: Knowledge Base (job location, and the job boards LoopCV searches in each market)

AU.note: LoopCV searches SEEK, plus LinkedIn and Indeed, for Australian jobs and sends applications for you by email or web form; its help page does not say whether it can auto-apply on SEEK itself. SEEK has no agent of its own that applies for you.

evidence.title: Knowledge Base (job location, and the job boards LoopCV searches in each market)

NG.note: JobCopilot says it auto-applies to jobs at companies worldwide, and Nigerian job listings on GrabJobs carry an "Auto-Apply with AI" button that uses it; LoopCV searches LinkedIn worldwide but does not list Nigeria. Jobberman, the main local job board, only sends job alerts and offers one-click applying that you do yourself.

evidence.title: JobCopilot: automatically apply to jobs

capabilities.name: Run payroll and HR paperwork for a small business
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent run payroll or finish an HR task, such as filing a form, for a small business?

US.note: Gusto's agents run payroll after the owner confirms a preview, but only for some customers: Cofounder (launched June 2026) is in invite-only early access, and running payroll from the Gusto app in ChatGPT is open to select customers. Intuit's Payroll Agent in QuickBooks Workforce runs payroll for the owner, but Intuit said in May 2026 only that it would reach eligible US customers in the coming weeks.

evidence.title: Introducing Gusto Cofounder: AI that knows your business and gets to work
Getting started with Gusto Cofounder (early access)
Gusto launches payroll inside ChatGPT
Intuit unveils QuickBooks Workforce, radically transforming human capital management for small- and mid-market businesses

GB.note: Deel's AI Workforce flags payroll errors before payout and handles managers' time-off requests, but no source says it approves a request or runs payroll on its own. We found no UK payroll provider whose agent runs payroll. Xero's Cash Flow Actions (beta) builds plans to protect payroll but does not run it, and we searched Sage Copilot (Nov 2026) and found no UK payroll agent.

evidence.title: Deel launches AI Workforce
The Big Deel 2026: Everything We Announced

DE.note: Personio's AI Assistant answers employees' HR questions, and Deel's AI Workforce flags payroll errors before payout and handles managers' time-off requests, but no source says it approves a request or runs payroll on its own. We searched Personio and DATEV (Nov 2026); no primary source shows a payroll agent in Germany.

evidence.title: HUG 2025 feature updates (AI Assistant for all employees)
Deel launches AI Workforce

IN.note: Kredily's Kai (shipped August 2026) works out the month's payroll, payslips and bank file, but it stops before payout and statutory filing, which stay with the owner; Kredily does not say whether Kai is open to all customers. We searched Zoho Payroll, Keka and RazorpayX (Nov 2026) and found no payroll agent from them.

evidence.title: Best AI payroll software in India (Kai payroll agent)

BR.note: Deel's AI Workforce flags payroll errors before payout and handles managers' time-off requests, but no source says it approves a request or runs payroll on its own, or sends eSocial events. LG lugar de gente plans payroll-checking agents in its 2026 roadmap, with no date. We searched Omie and Contabilizei (Nov 2026); Omie's agents cover accounting and tax tasks, and we found no payroll agent.

evidence.title: Deel launches AI Workforce
Roadmap Nuvem 2026 (June update)

MX.note: Deel's AI Workforce flags payroll errors before payout and handles managers' time-off requests, but no source says it approves a request or runs payroll on its own, or files with IMSS or SAT. We searched Runa and Worky (Nov 2026) and found no payroll agent from either.

evidence.title: Deel launches AI Workforce

CL.note: Deel's AI Workforce flags payroll errors before payout and handles managers' time-off requests, but no source says it approves a request or runs payroll on its own. We searched Buk and Talana (Nov 2026) and found no payroll agent from either.

evidence.title: Deel launches AI Workforce

CO.note: Aleluya's AI agent checks payroll before you pay, and Deel's AI Workforce flags payroll errors before payout and handles managers' time-off requests, but no source says it approves a request or runs payroll on its own; no agent sends the electronic payroll to DIAN. We searched Siigo and Alegra (Nov 2026) and found no payroll agent from either.

evidence.title: Aleluya vs Siigo, Buk, Siesa y Loggro: compara tu nómina
Deel launches AI Workforce

ES.note: Factorial, the Barcelona HR firm, launched its One AI agent in October 2026 and says it executes tasks, but no source says it runs payroll or files an HR form on its own; Deel's AI Workforce flags payroll errors but does not run payroll.

evidence.title: Factorial completes the jump to AI for companies with a new personal agent
Deel launches AI Workforce

FR.note: PayFit AI, inside the French payroll service PayFit, answers employees' HR questions and does some tasks for the employer, such as passing on variable pay items and building HR reports, but PayFit's experts run the payroll and file the social declarations (DSN).

evidence.title: Payfit: logiciel de paie et RH (Payfit AI)
PayFit launches first personalised AI agent to answer workers' queries on their contract, pay and leave

CA.note: No payroll provider for Canadian small businesses was found whose agent runs payroll: Wagepoint markets AI-assisted payroll, AskPayroll is a copilot for payroll staff, and Workday's Canadian Payroll Agent targets large employers.

evidence.title: Workday Payroll for Canada (datasheet)

JP.note: We found no Japanese payroll provider whose agent runs payroll or files a form on its own; freee, Money Forward and SmartHR announced no such agent, and a 2026 market review found no payroll AI that pays without a person's approval.

evidence.title: 2026年版 給与計算向けAIエージェント12選

AU.note: Employment Hero's HeroForce (April 2026) uses AI to work out awards and payroll, but as an employer-of-record service with people checking the work, not an agent that runs payroll for the business. We found no Xero or MYOB agent that runs payroll.

evidence.title: Employment Hero becomes the legal employer with new AI system

NG.note: Payroll tools for Nigerian small firms, such as Salario (free, March 2026), calculate PAYE, pension and statutory filings, and HONO markets an AI-native payroll, but no source shows an AI agent that runs payroll or files a form on its own.

evidence.title: Salario Launches Free Payroll Solution to Help Nigerian SMEs Improve Tax Compliance
